top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a prediction and an observation that match: Kane and Mele's Z2 invariant and protected helical edge states, and Molenkamp's HgTe quantum-well realisation, with about two decades of independent confirmation. It is a new classification of band structure in real crystals and so distinct from the 2016 prize on topological phases in model systems. The citation must stay restricted to the quantum spin Hall state and Z2 topological insulators and be open that Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and Hasan's 3D work are separate steps outside the three names. I still prefer it to the lattice clocks of P002 because I want a discovery or invention rather than a large improvement in accuracy of a system earlier prizes recognised, although P002 has the cleaner credit and I would accept it without reservation. Either is better than no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented tie to Kane, Mele, Molenkamp, Katori or Ye. Goran Johansson is a Chalmers colleague but works in circuit QED, which is not in this slate.
